preview.command: npm run build followed by npm run preview:grocery; use the normal offers and opportunities build flags
preview.indexing: noindex, nofollow, noarchive; robots.txt disallows all
preview.analytics: External embedded requests and inline trackers blocked by preview-only CSP; shared mobile navigation explicitly allowed.

editorialFindings.stores: Official directories reviewed for Best Before, Foodeez and Looters; regional coverage and source inconsistencies are stated in the guides.

basketClaim.limitation: Reported selected 21-product promotional basket containing food and household goods. Arithmetic and attribution checked; supermarket comparator prices were not independently reproduced. Not a general cheapest-store or household saving claim.

excluded: Foodeez poster specials dated 12-18 October: end today, unsuitable as durable launch offers.
Looters Brookes lemon juice: conflicting price, pack and promotional information.
Looters Koo mixed vegetables multi-buy attribute: not sufficiently clear to publish as a qualifying offer.
All retailer crossed-out prices and claimed percentage savings: not independently verified.
limits: No store visits, checkout, test purchase or physical stock inspection.
All three exact batch best-before dates are unavailable online.
Displayed product prices exclude delivery. Address-specific delivery charges remain unverified.
No independent same-product supermarket saving or search-volume claim established.

artwork.type: Official retailer store photographs and product images, optimized locally
artwork.limits: Store photographs are identified as archival. Pictured shelf prices and stock are not price-check evidence. No endorsement or image licence claim made.

beforePublication: Check remote divergence, commit and push the approved scope, then verify deployment and live routes, images and sitemap.

ackermans.reason: Held on 18 October 2026 because official sources conflict: the blog terms say 30 October with website or social entry, while the live entry-form rules say 31 October with compulsory website entry and optional social sharing. Do not restore active recommendations until the promoter reconciles the terms.
ackermans.additionalConflicts: Official blog terms and the linked live ViralSweep entry form were inspected on 18 October 2026. The form also specifies R12,000 in vouchers as 12 monthly R1,000 vouchers, and winner notification/announcement by 25/30 November; the blog gives 13/20 November. Historical listing facts are retained for review, not approved as current entry instructions. No entry was submitted.

goldiArchiveWarning.action: Recorded the exact reviewed archive 404 in the existing warning baseline. No Goldi content or active-listing approval changed.
